說明: 《畫海人》主要角色的定稿立繪（不放進遊戲，只當插圖的參考圖）。looks 是每個角色的固定外觀描述，劇情清單的插圖用 chars 欄位引用。candidates 表示還沒選定（2026-10-11 全部已選定，picked 記錄選的是哪一張候選）：先畫幾張候選（種子連續），選好後把種子改成選中的那張、拿掉 candidates。執行：python 畫海人/tools/生圖/batch.py --list 清單_角色.json

style.design: Anime character design illustration in the same hand-painted anime film style as the game's scenes: clean crisp line art, cel shading with soft painterly highlights, highly detailed costume with visible fabric folds, stitching, buckles, straps and accessories, detailed hair strands and expressive eyes. Bright, neutral, even lighting with clear true colors, no dark color grading, no heavy shadows. Medieval European fantasy costume design. The character's signature color theme is clearly visible.
style.negative_design: text, letters, words, signature, watermark, logo, border, frame, speech bubble, photograph, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, chibi, dark gloomy lighting, low key lighting, heavy shadows, scenery background, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, deformed, bad anatomy, extra fingers, extra limbs, missing fingers, duplicate figures, multiple views, collage, split image, cropped feet, modern clothing, guns, asian clothing, kimono

looks.墨里: a 17-year-old girl (female, soft feminine face), short black chin-length bob hair with a single white streak on the right side, pale grey left eye and dark brown right eye, calm observant expression, weathered deep-blue sailor coat with many pockets and brass buttons, cream linen shirt, dark trousers, knee-high brown leather boots, brown leather satchel worn across her body, a slender pen with a softly glowing gold tip tucked behind her left ear.
looks.阿潮: a 17-year-old fisherman's son, tanned skin, messy spiky short dark-brown hair, thick eyebrows, stubborn frowning mouth, rough linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, worn brown leather vest, teal scarf around his neck, a faded red cloth strip tied around his left wrist, a falchion at his hip: a short, broad, slightly curved single-edged sword like a heavy cleaver, with one sharp edge and a thick flat back.
looks.蓮笙: a quiet 15-year-old girl, very long straight black hair with a blue tint, a single white flower pinned in her hair, pale skin, half-lowered pale violet-grey eyes, grey hooded robe of the fog keepers with lavender lining, bundles of dried herbs and small glass vials hanging at her waist, holding a long thin bone needle.
looks.小鈴: a cheerful 20-year-old wandering bard woman, long wavy chestnut hair in a loose braid with a small brass bell tied at the end, freckles, amber eyes, mustard-yellow travelling cloak over an olive-brown vest, a lute slung on her back, a leather-bound songbook hanging at her belt.
looks.費米: a 19-year-old merchant's son with a sly half-smile, short sandy-blond hair, sharp green eyes, a wide-brimmed hat worn low, rust-orange short doublet fastened with small silver seashell buttons, holding a short bow, a quiver on his back, a small ledger book at his belt.
looks.葛蘿: a tall broad-shouldered 58-year-old woman, former pirate captain, cropped grey hair, old scars on her weathered face, calm heavy gaze, she is an amputee with only ONE arm: her left arm is completely missing from the shoulder, so on her left side there is no arm and no hand at all, and the empty left sleeve is folded and pinned up against her side; her single right arm holds a short hand axe. Deep crimson cloak thrown back over the left shoulder, worn leather armor.
looks.老洛: a thin elderly cartographer about 75 years old, white stubble beard, a black eye patch over his right eye and a round monocle on his left eye, worn grey long coat, holding an old wooden measuring rod, a small grey lantern hanging at his belt.
looks.霧子: a young swordswoman about 20 years old, frost-white short hair, very pale skin, grey-blue eyes with an empty searching expression, long dark slate-grey coat, an old longsword whose hilt is engraved with a pen and a star.
looks.嘎嘎: an old talking sea turtle as big as a handcart, his shell covered in barnacles and strands of seaweed, wrinkled dark green-grey skin, droopy gentle slightly comical eyes, holding an old seaweed rope in his mouth.
looks.母親: the mother of the 17-year-old girl, a woman who looks about 38 years old, long black hair tied in a low ponytail with a single white streak on the right side, gentle but tired eyes, pale grey travelling cloak over a deep-blue guild apprentice coat, a slender pen glowing pale blue tucked behind her ear.
looks.公會長: the Guild Master, a tall gaunt old man who looks about 70, long silver hair tied back, neatly trimmed beard, tired but obsessive eyes, deep-blue robe with gold trim and ink-stained sleeves, a guild badge of a pen and a star on his chest, holding a long pen whose tip glows white-gold.
